  "type": "support_article",
  "articleId": "000001612",
  "title": "For Teachers: How to reset passwords for yourself and students",
  "url": "https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001612?language=en_US",
  "audience": "Teachers",
  "language": "en_US",
  "text": "This article contains the following:  
1\. [Overview](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001612#header1)  
2\. [Resetting teacher passwords](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001612#header2)  
         •[Setting up account recovery](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001612#accountrecovery)  
         •[Recovering your account and resetting your password on the Clever login page](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001612#resettingpwloginscreen)[](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001612#thirdparty)  
         •[Resetting your password in Clever Portal](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001612#resettingincleverportal)  
3\. [Resetting student passwords](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001612#header3)  
4\. [Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ)](https://support.clever.com/s/articles/000001612#FAQ)

## Overview

Not being able to log in is no fun. However, if your school organization is using Clever passwords, Active Directory, Entra ID, or Google Workspace as a login method, you may be able to reset your password and the passwords of your students (students may also have the ability to reset their passwords). This depends on whether your school district has enabled this feature, and which login methods they have enabled for it.   
 

* * *

## Resetting teacher passwords

Not all school organizations allow teachers to reset their passwords. If you don’t see the option to reset your password, or if these steps don't resolve the issue, please get in touch with your [school organization's tech support contact](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/360039685112#h_10633fd3-0e42-4374-b7ae-efee35619efd) directly for help.

### **Setting up account recovery**

If your school has enabled it, you can use a backup method (such as email, security questions, or phone number) to regain access to your Clever, Active Directory, Entra ID, and Google Workspace accounts right from your Clever login screen. This is handy if you cannot log in with your password successfully.

To set up your backup method (again, if your school had enabled this functionality), you need to be logged into your Portal.

1.  Click on your blue icon in the upper right corner to bring up your settings.   
    
2.  Click on **Set up recovery methods.** The recovery methods available to you depend on what your school organization has enabled.
    
3.  Choose a recovery method and input the information.
    
4.  Depending on what you choose for a recovery method, you will be prompted on how to continue.
    

![Gif of setting up a recovery method](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000cOR7&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl00000El83h)

It’s also possible that your school organization may have provided a recovery method for you using information in their records. For example, if your schools collect personal email addresses, they may set up your account recovery email as your personal email address. If you’d like to update the information your school organization provides, you can do so using the recovery method setup described above.

### **Recovering your account and resetting your password on the Clever login screen**

### **To reset Clever and third-party passwords:**

1.  From the Clever login screen, click on **get help logging in.**
2.  Choose **Reset your account passwords.  
    ![Reset your account passwords screen](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000cOR7&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl00000El9vp)** 
3.  Input your school organization email address (not to be confused with a recovery email you have set up).   
    ![Account recovery](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000cOR7&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl00000ElATh) 
4.  You’ll be prompted to confirm your identity using a method you set up in your Portal settings. Select how you’ll confirm your identity.
5.  You can now set up your new password for both your Clever and third-party accounts by inputting a new password. Your school may have password requirements, which can be viewed by clicking on **See requirements**. Once completed, you can use your new password for your third-party account(s).  
      
    ![Screenshot of the set a new password screen](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000cOR7&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl0000020isj)

### **To reset Clever and third-party passwords:**

1.  Select **Get help logging in!** to reset your password using the email address linked to your school organization's Clever account.  
      
    ![Login page showing an error](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000cOR7&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl0000020hqD)  
      
    
2.  Choose **Reset only your Clever password  
      
    ![Reset only your Clever Password](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000cOR7&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl00000ElCth)** 
3.  Enter the email that you signed up with to receive password reset instructions, and click **Send.  
      
    ![Screenshot of the Recover account page](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000cOR7&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl0000020hdK)**

### **Resetting your password in Clever Portal**

Alternatively, if you do have access to your Teacher Portal and want to update your password for any reason (e.g., you feel your passwords may have been compromised), you can do so by following these steps from your Teacher Portal:

1.  Click on your blue icon in the upper right corner to bring up your settings.  
    ![Screenshot of the Password reset option in Clever Portal](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000cOR7&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl00000ElCKE) 
2.  From underneath **Log in password** click **Change passwords** to update**.** 

This is independent of the account recovery process and doesn’t require you to go through the recovery method.

   **![pencil](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000cOR7&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl00000EkWMe)   Please note:** Your school organization's settings will determine which passwords you can reset through Clever. In the screenshot above you’ll see this user will reset both their Google and Clever password. Please pay close attention to the passwords you are resetting.

* * *

## Resetting student passwords

If your school has enabled it, you can reset student passwords for **Log in with Clever** and third-Party accounts. Best of all, it can be done right from your Teacher Portal! 

To update a student’s password:

1.  Click on **My Students** in the menu on the left side of your Teacher Portal.
2.  Choose **Student Roster**.
3.  You can find the student by filtering by class and then clicking on the student from the roster.
4.  You’ll see **Student Tools** on the right side of the Portal under the student’s name. From there, click on **Set new password**. Depending on your district’s settings, this will reset the student password for any login method managed by Clever.  
    ![GIF for resetting student password](/servlet/rtaImage?eid=ka0Pl000000cOR7&feoid=00N1P00000A2RcS&refid=0EMPl00000El1Jy)   
       
    _In the video above, you'll see the student passwords will be reset for both Google and Clever passwords.  
    _
    
    Once updated, your student should be able to log in successfully with the new password you've created.
    
    If your school has enabled it, students may also be able to reset their own passwords. To see how students can reset their own accounts, check out this article: [For Students: Troubleshooting - Logging in to Clever](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/115002717307).  
      
    

* * *

## Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ)

**How long do I need to wait after resetting my password before logging in?**

-   You can login immediately after resetting your password!
    

**What if I don’t have the option to reset my password?**

-   Reach out to your [school organization's tech support contact](https://support.clever.com/hc/s/articles/360039685112#h_10633fd3-0e42-4374-b7ae-efee35619efd) for further assistance.
    

**Can Clever reset my password for me or tell me what my password is?**

-   No, the Clever Support team cannot reset your password for you or provide you with your password. Please reach out to your school organization directly if you’re having issues with your password.
    

**What are the password reset requirements?**

-   Passwords cannot start/end with a space
-   Characters cannot repeat more than 3 times
-   Passwords cannot contain any part of the user’s name
